Claire — thanks for the heads up, and sorry about the friction.

Quick technical note (so you know what we're changing): forwarded invites sometimes convert times into "floating" iCalendar entries (no TZ ID), which causes Google to interpret them in the recipient's local zone and can shift the hour when crossing CET/PST/EDT. To avoid that we should:

1) Send a new .ics anchored to UTC (DTSTART with TZID or explicit Z suffix)
2) Avoid recurrence rules or EXDATEs in the initial invite
3) Copy the admin so their mail system gets the canonical event rather than a forwarded copy

I'm attaching a fixed .ics that I generated (redwood-demo-fixed.ics) — it sets DTSTART:20270318T150000Z (which maps to 16:00 CET / 11:00 ET / 08:00 PT on Thu Mar 18). Evelyn — can you send the new invite using that file and ask Claire/admin to accept?
